༄༅/ /nags sman gtor chog bdud rtsi thig pa zhes bya ba lha btsan gyi gtor bsngo dang bcas pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nags sman gtor chog bdud rtsi thig pa zhes

bya ba lha btsan gyi gtor bsngo dang bcas pa bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a t+ya nu t+pan+na twa ta/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod nang du oṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ dam pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdag dang*/ /rnal 'byor sgrub brtson bskyod phyir spyan 'dren gyis/ /tshur byon mchod gtor bzhes slad 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi e h+ya hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ nags sman rgyal mo sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil/ sman 'phral 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ mchod sby-in gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ 'gal rkye?n bsrung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i gtong grogs mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi sa pā rī wa ra bh+yaḥn ma sarba ta tha ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa e maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa dam ba ling ta ye swāhā/ lan lnga'i 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi amṛ ta la kha raṃ kha hi/ zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ bh+yoḥ gang gi rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig dang*/ /de 'dzin rnal 'byor tshogs rnams skyongs mdzad cing*/ /'gro ba kun la ma ltar byams pa yi/ /ma cig nags sman rgyal mor bstod par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*/ /sems can kun la bde skyid mdzod/ khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /'gal rkyen bsrung la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis che btsan 'khor bcas a kar+ṣa dzaḥ de ba shu la dri yang dzaḥ sa pa ri wa ra aṃ ku shā dzaḥ

badz+ra a ral+li ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de ba shū la dri yaṃ dzaḥ a kā ro/ btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga ru/ /srog gi snying po dam la phul nas kyang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas par/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po khyed la bstod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba/ / sogs gong bzhin/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa thā naṃ/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya/ zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // dge'o// tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - 191 --190 -
